name: Groq, Inc.
monetization: Designs LPU inference accelerators and sells inference tokens-as-a-service via GroqCloud; monetized its core IP via a ~$20B non-exclusive technology license to NVIDIA (announced late Dec 2025), after which the cloud business continues independently.
description_md: Groq built deterministic low-latency inference chips (LPUs) and a fast-growing inference cloud, with flagship international deployments via Humain/Aramco in Saudi Arabia. In late December 2025 NVIDIA paid ~$20B in cash for a non-exclusive license to Groq's inference technology and hired senior leadership including founder-CEO Jonathan Ross — a 'not-acqui-hire' structure that US senators later questioned as evading merger review. Groq re-staffed under new leadership and raised $650M in June 2026 to keep operating GroqCloud.

observations.notes: Pre-NVIDIA-deal valuation from its Sept 2025 round; June 2026 $650M re-raise terms not fully disclosed.
